```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=F,include=F}
new_diag <- function(usr, col = '#A6A6A6') {
  lims <- c(max(usr[1], usr[3]), min(usr[2], usr[4]))
  
  segments(
    lims[1], lims[1],
    lims[2], lims[2],
    lwd = 1.5,
    col = alpha(col, 0.75),
    lty = 5
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=F,include=F}
# Keep metric names consistent in figure labels without changing data-column names.
metric_label <- function(label) {
  if (!is.character(label) || length(label) != 1) {
    return(label)
  }

  labels <- list(
    "regP" = expression("RegP"),
    "RegP" = expression("RegP"),
    "Regulatory Potential" = expression("RegP"),
    "Regulatory potential" = expression("RegP"),
    "regP_FH" = expression("RegP"~"(iFH)"),
    "RegP_FH" = expression("RegP"~"(iFH)"),
    "F&H regP" = expression("RegP"~"(iFH)"),
    "regP_F" = expression("RegP"~"(iF)"),
    "RegP_F" = expression("RegP"~"(iF)"),
    "F regP" = expression("RegP"~"(iF)"),
    "regP_H" = expression("RegP"~"(iH)"),
    "RegP_H" = expression("RegP"~"(iH)"),
    "H regP" = expression("RegP"~"(iH)"),
    "EC50" = expression("EC"[textstyle("50")]),
    "EC50_FH" = expression("EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iFH)"),
    "EC50_F" = expression("EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iF)"),
    "EC50_H" = expression("EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iH)"),
    "n" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "nH" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "n_H" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "n_Hill" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "Hill coefficient" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "Hill coefficient n" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "n_FH" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iFH)"),
    "n_F" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iF)"),
    "n_H_condition" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iH)"),
    "n_H_FH" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iFH)"),
    "n_H_F" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iF)"),
    "n_H_H" = expression("n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iH)"),
    "Abasal" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "basal" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "basal activity" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "Abasal_FH" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iFH)"),
    "Abasal_F" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iF)"),
    "Abasal_H" = expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iH)"),
    "delta regP" = expression(Delta*"RegP"),
    "delta regP_FH" = expression(Delta*"RegP"~"(iFH)"),
    "delta regP_F" = expression(Delta*"RegP"~"(iF)"),
    "delta regP_H" = expression(Delta*"RegP"~"(iH)"),
    "delta EC50_FH" = expression(Delta*"EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iFH)"),
    "delta EC50_F" = expression(Delta*"EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iF)"),
    "delta EC50_H" = expression(Delta*"EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iH)"),
    "delta EC50" = expression(Delta*"EC"[textstyle("50")]),
    "delta n_H" = expression(Delta*"n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "delta n_H_FH" = expression(Delta*"n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iFH)"),
    "delta n_H_F" = expression(Delta*"n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iF)"),
    "delta n_H_H" = expression(Delta*"n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iH)"),
    "delta Abasal" = expression(Delta*"A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "delta Abasal_FH" = expression(Delta*"A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iFH)"),
    "delta Abasal_F" = expression(Delta*"A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iF)"),
    "delta Abasal_H" = expression(Delta*"A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iH)")
  )
  if (!is.null(labels[[label]])) {
    return(labels[[label]])
  }

  parts <- regexec("^(o1|o2) (.+)$", label)
  match <- regmatches(label, parts)[[1]]
  if (length(match) == 3) {
    inner <- metric_label(match[3])
    if (!is.character(inner)) {
      return(as.expression(substitute(prefix~metric,
                                      list(prefix=match[2], metric=inner[[1]]))))
    }
  }
  label
}

metric_label_with_text <- function(label, suffix) {
  metric <- metric_label(label)
  if (is.character(metric)) {
    return(paste(metric, suffix))
  }
  as.expression(substitute(metric~suffix,
                           list(metric=metric[[1]], suffix=suffix)))
}
```

### predicted dual effect over single effects

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3.8,  echo=F,  out.width="\\linewidth", warning=F, results='show',dpi=600}
predict_log2_activity_over_basal_at <- function(conc, par_table) {
  predicted_activity <- t(sapply(row.names(par_table), function(seq_id) {
    par_here <- list(basal=par_table[seq_id,]$basal,
                     Fmax=par_table[seq_id,]$Fmax,
                     Kd=par_table[seq_id,]$Kd,
                     n=par_table[seq_id,]$n)
    hill_equation(par_here, conc)
  }))
  colnames(predicted_activity) <- paste0("c", seq_along(conc), "_", signif(conc, 4))
  log2(predicted_activity/par_table[row.names(predicted_activity),]$basal)
}

fh_diag_n <- 300
f_conc_diag <- exp(seq(log(min(conc_foxa1)), log(max(conc_foxa1)), length.out=fh_diag_n))
h_conc_diag <- exp(seq(log(min(conc_hnf4a)), log(max(conc_hnf4a)), length.out=fh_diag_n))
fh_conc_diag <- f_conc_diag*h_conc_diag
hepG2_foxa1_conc <- 49.27642992
hepG2_hnf4a_conc <- 26.53009141

dual_over_single_group <- function(patt1=""){
  test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste("aff_.*",patt1,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  number_of_tfs <- data.frame(c=rep(NA,length(test_set)),row.names = test_set)
  for (i in c(1:length(test_set))) {
    number_of_tfs[test_set[i],] <- rank(-fh_ka[test_set,])[i]
  }
  setcol <- viridis(max(number_of_tfs$c))

  gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_pred <- gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh
  gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_pred$n <- gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_pred$n/2

  k1f_log2_diag <- predict_log2_activity_over_basal_at(f_conc_diag, gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[test_set,,drop=FALSE])
  k3h_log2_diag <- predict_log2_activity_over_basal_at(h_conc_diag, gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[test_set,,drop=FALSE])
  k4fh_log2_diag <- predict_log2_activity_over_basal_at(fh_conc_diag, gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh_pred[test_set,,drop=FALSE])
  k4fh_over_single_log2_diag <- k4fh_log2_diag[test_set,] -
    (k1f_log2_diag[test_set,] + k3h_log2_diag[test_set,])

  list(test_set=test_set,
       number_of_tfs=number_of_tfs,
       setcol=setcol,
       k4fh_over_single_log2_diag=k4fh_over_single_log2_diag)
}

draw_dual_over_single_group <- function(group_data, ylim){
  test_set <- group_data$test_set
  number_of_tfs <- group_data$number_of_tfs
  setcol <- group_data$setcol
  k4fh_over_single_log2_diag <- group_data$k4fh_over_single_log2_diag

  plot(fh_conc_diag, k4fh_over_single_log2_diag[1,],
       log="x", type="n", axes=FALSE, ann=FALSE,
       ylim=ylim)
  for (seq_id in test_set[order(-fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean[test_set,]$s1)]) {
    lines(fh_conc_diag, k4fh_over_single_log2_diag[seq_id,],
          col="white", lwd=1.5)
    lines(fh_conc_diag, k4fh_over_single_log2_diag[seq_id,],
          col=alpha(setcol[number_of_tfs[seq_id,"c"]], 1), lwd=1)
  }
  axis(1, at=fh_labels, labels=f_c_labels, lwd=1, tck=-0.015,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(3, at=fh_labels, labels=h_c_labels, lwd=1, tck=-0.015,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(2, lwd=1, tck=-0.015, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black",
       padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  title(ylab="FH - (F + H)", xlab="[FOXA1] (nM)", line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
  abline(h=0, col=alpha("black",0.8), lty=5, lwd=1.2)
  abline(v=hepG2_foxa1_conc*hepG2_hnf4a_conc, col=alpha("black",0.8), lty=5, lwd=1.2)
  box()
}

}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3.8,  echo=F,  out.width="\\linewidth", warning=F, results='show',dpi=600}
log_axis_ticks <- function(lims, base_ticks=c(1,2,5)) {
  ticks <- as.vector(outer(base_ticks, 10^(floor(log10(lims[1])):ceiling(log10(lims[2])))))
  ticks <- sort(unique(ticks[ticks >= lims[1] & ticks <= lims[2]]))
  labels <- format(signif(ticks, 3), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE)
  list(at=ticks, labels=labels)
}
```

### affinity main

```{r eval=T, echo=F, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=3, warning=FALSE, results='show',dpi=300}
add_group <- function(fh_ka,fc_k4fh,error,patt1,col="black",cor_print=TRUE,addline=TRUE,logy=FALSE,addc="aff_.*",pch_=1,error_ylim=NULL){
  test_set <-unique(c(bc_full_list[grep(paste(addc,patt1,sep=""),bc_full_list)],bc_full_list[grep(paste("aff_.*",patt1,sep=""),bc_full_list)]))
  #test_set <-unique(c(smallError_list3[grep(paste(addc,patt1,sep=""),smallError_list3)],smallError_list3[grep(paste("aff_.*",patt1,sep=""),smallError_list3)]))
  points(fh_ka[test_set,],fc_k4fh[test_set,],col=col,bg=alpha(col,0.5),pch=pch_,cex=1,lwd=1.5)
  error_low <- fc_k4fh[test_set,]-error[test_set,]
  error_high <- fc_k4fh[test_set,]+error[test_set,]
  if (!is.null(error_ylim)) {
    error_low <- pmax(error_low,error_ylim[1])
    error_high <- pmin(error_high,error_ylim[2])
  }
  arrows(fh_ka[test_set,], error_low, fh_ka[test_set,], error_high,
         length=.0, angle=90, code=3,col=col,xpd=FALSE)
  if(logy){
      fit_y <- log(fc_k4fh[test_set,])
  }else{
    fit_y <- (fc_k4fh[test_set,])
  }

  line_tmp <- lm(fit_y~log(fh_ka[test_set,]))
      mtext(paste("R = ",round(cor(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),fit_y,use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),2),sep=""),side = 1,line = -runif(1,1,4),col=col,adj=1)
  if(addline){
    if(logy){  lines(c(min((fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T),max((fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)),c(exp(min(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)*line_tmp$coefficients[2]+line_tmp$coefficients[1]),exp(max(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)*line_tmp$coefficients[2]+line_tmp$coefficients[1])),col=col,lwd=2)
}else{  lines(c(min((fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T),max((fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)),c((min(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)*line_tmp$coefficients[2]+line_tmp$coefficients[1]),(max(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),na.rm = T)*line_tmp$coefficients[2]+line_tmp$coefficients[1])),col=col,lwd=2)
}
  }
  if(cor_print){
    print(patt1)
    print(cor(log(fh_ka[test_set,]),fit_y,use="pairwise.complete.obs"))
    
  }
}
```  

```{r eval=T, echo=F, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=2.25, warning=FALSE, results='show' ,dpi=300}
affinity_four <- function(kd_score_F_table,gHill_par_foxa1_k1f,gHill_std_foxa1_k4fh,xlab_=expression("-("*Delta*"G"["FOXA1"]*"(-kcal/mol)"),energy_ticks=c(-9.5,-10,-10.5),list=smallError_list,ylim_kd=c(0,170),ec50_ticks=c(20,80,140)){

  affinity_one("Kd",kd_score_F_table,gHill_par_foxa1_k1f,gHill_std_foxa1_k4fh,ylim_=ylim_kd,ylabels=ec50_ticks,ylab_="EC50",xlab_="",energy_ticks=energy_ticks,list=list[which(gHill_std_foxa1_k4fh[list,"Kd",drop=T]<abs(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[list,"Kd",drop=T]))])

}
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=4, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
hist_all3c <-function(toplot,std_df=NA,ylab,CRE_prefix=fh_candidate,patt1 = "FHsfla",patt2="ho1_",patt3="",ylim=c(0,1),ylabels=c(0,100,200,300),logy=FALSE,grid=c(1,2,3,4)){
    test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,".*",patt2,patt3,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  hist((toplot[test_set,]), probability = FALSE, col = "white", main = "",border="white",ylim=ylim,axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE)

  title(ylab="Density",xlab="", line=1.5, cex.lab=1.)

      for (i in CRE_prefix) {
   test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,".*",patt2,i,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  dens <- density(toplot[test_set,],na.rm=TRUE)
  dens$y <- dens$y * length(test_set)
  lines(dens, col = (col_df[i,]), lwd = 2)
  polygon(dens, col = alpha(col_df[i,],.3), border = NA)

    }

}

df <- data.frame(
  group =gsub("_[FH].*$","", gsub("aff_","",test_set)),
  value = toplot[test_set,]
)

ggplot(df, aes(x=group, y=value, fill=group)) +
  geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot(trim=FALSE,width = 0.1,fill="white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(col_df$c,row.names(col_df) ))+
  theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  #axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
  panel.background = element_blank()
  )+labs(
    x = "",

  )
 # axis.ticks = element_blank())
  }
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=2.25, fig.height=2.85,  echo=F,  warning=F, results='show', dpi=300 }
tfbsn_groups <- function(data_, group,logy="",ylab_="",linesadd=FALSE,base_col = "#9075ab",yat=c(0,1,2,3),ylabel=NA,prefix="aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH",tfname="HNF4A"){#"#E86F77"
  test <- cor.test(data_[[group]], data_$fn,method = "spearman")
  test <- wilcox.test(data_[[group]]~ data_$fn,digits.rank	=2)
  n <- length(unique(data_$fn))
  med <- tapply(data_[[group]], data_$fn, mean)
  se <- tapply(data_[[group]], data_$fn, function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)))
  y_min <- min(c(med,med - se),na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(c(med,med + se),na.rm = TRUE)
  pad <- 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)
  grad <- (colorRampPalette(c("white", base_col))(n+1))
  boxplot(as.formula(paste(group, "~ fn")) , data = data_,log=logy,col = grad[-1],axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE,lwd = 0.75,medlwd = 0.8)
  if(all(is.na(ylabel))){
  axis(2, at = yat,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  }else{
      axis(2, at = yat,labels = ylabel,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  }
  axis(1, at = c(1,2), labels = c(1,2),lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-1.9, cex.axis=0.8)
    title(ylab=metric_label(ylab_),xlab=paste0("# of ",tfname," sites"), line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
  box()
  #main=paste("p=",test$p.value,"\nrho=",as.numeric(test$estimate),sep = "")
  names <- row.names(data_)
  

  if(linesadd){
    #grep("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH2.2",names)
    for (i in c(1:5,"")) {
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0(prefix,"1",i,"5"),group],data_[paste0(prefix,"2",i,"2"),group]),lwd=0.5)
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0(prefix,"5",i,"1"),group],data_[paste0(prefix,"2",i,"2"),group]),lwd=0.5)
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0(prefix,"1","5",i),group],data_[paste0(prefix,"2","2",i),group]),lwd=0.5)
      lines(c(1,2),c(data_[paste0(prefix,"5","1",i),group],data_[paste0(prefix,"2","2",i),group]),lwd=0.5)

    }
  }
  if(test$p.value>0.1){
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(test$p.value, 3))
  }else{
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(test$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }
  
  #p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 2))
  x_range <- range(data_$fn)
  y_range <- range(data_[[group]], na.rm = TRUE)

  x_pos <- x_range[2] - 0.01 * diff(x_range)
  y_pos <- y_range[1] + 0.1 * diff(y_range)
  #text(x_pos, y_pos, labels = p_text, pos = 1, cex = 1.1)
  mtext(p_text, side = 3, line = 0.5, cex = 0.9)
  # x <- as.numeric(names(med))
  # plot(x, med,ylim=c(y_min - pad, y_max + pad),xlab="BS #",ylab=paste(ylab_,"group mean"))
  # arrows(x, med - se, x, med + se,
  #        angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.05)
  # fit <- lm(med ~ x)
  # abline(fit, lwd = 1)
  # pval <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  # slope <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 1]
  # p_text <- paste0("slope = ", signif(slope, 3),
  #                 "\np = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 2))
  # #p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 2))
  # x_range <- range(x)
  # y_range <- range(med + se, na.rm = TRUE)
  # 
  # x_pos <- x_range[2] - 0.01 * diff(x_range)
  # y_pos <- y_range[2] - 0.1 * diff(y_range)
  # text(x_pos, y_pos, labels = p_text, pos = 2, cex = 1.1)
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=2.5, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
draw_group <- function(patt1="",test_set){
#test_set <-bc_full_list[grep(paste("aff_.*",patt1,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
#test_set <-c("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH521","aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH543")
#test_set <-c("aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH511","aff_chr2_231915124_231915324_FH212")

#test_set <- test_set[which(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[test_set,]$r2>0.9)]
  number_of_tfs <- data.frame(c=rep(NA,length(test_set)),row.names = test_set)
  for (i in c(1:length(test_set))) {
    tmp <-  gsub(".*_FH","",i)
    #number_of_tfs[i,] <- sum(as.numeric(strsplit(tmp,"")[[1]]))
    number_of_tfs[test_set[i],] <- rank(-fh_ka[test_set,])[i]
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.8,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
pos_anova_per_param <- function(col,x=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh){
  df_foranova <- data.frame(y=x[all_test_set_o1,col],
                            x1=gsub("FHmovefho[0-9]_[0-9]*_","",all_test_set_o1),
                            x2=factor(sapply(strsplit(all_test_set_o1,"_"), `[`, 2)))
model <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df_foranova)

# ANOVA table
anova_out <- anova(model)
ss_total <- sum(anova_out$"Sum Sq")

# Add % variance explained column
anova_out$Percent <- (anova_out$"Sum Sq" / ss_total) * 100
anova_out}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=5, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
transparency_level <- 0.5
toplot <- gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=FALSE]
line_width <- 1.5
draw_regression_line <- function(x,y,col="gray"){
   #x <- loci[sorted_test_set,]
#y <- toplot[sorted_test_set,]
fit <- lm(y ~ x)
x_full <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 100)
y_full <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_full))
p_value <- summary(fit)$coefficients["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  lines(x_full, y_full, col = alpha("white",0.5), lwd = 1.5,lty=1)
  lines(x_full, y_full, col = col, lwd = 1,lty=5)
    if(p_value>0.1){
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))
  }else{
    p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2))
  }
  if(abs(coef(fit)["x"])>0.1){
  slope_text <- paste0("slope = ", signif(coef(fit)["x"], 3))  
}else{
    slope_text <- paste0("slope = ", formatC(coef(fit)["x"], format = "e", digits = 2))
}
  #p_text <- paste0("p = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 2))
  x_range <- range(x,na.rm = T)
  y_range <- range(y, na.rm = TRUE)

  x_pos <- x_range[2] - 0.5 * diff(x_range)
  y_pos <- y_range[1] + 0.2 * diff(y_range)
  text(x_pos, y_pos, labels = paste0(slope_text,"\n",p_text), pos = 1, cex = 0.8)
print(paste0(slope_text,"\n",p_text))
}

add_grid <- function(yat=c(0,1,2,3)){
  usr <- par("usr")
  for (i in yat) {
      lines(c(usr[1],usr[2]),c(i,i),col="lightgray",lty=1,lwd=0.75)

  }
}

position_canvas <- function(x=c(10:120),ylab="regP",ylim=c(-1.,7.5),grid=c(0,2,4,6),yat=c(0,2,4,6),logxy="",xat=c(22,52,82,112),xlab="Position (nt)",xlabels=NULL,top_position_axis=FALSE,top_xlab="Position (nt)",top_xlabels=xat){    
  if (is.null(xlabels)) {
    xlabels <- if (identical(xlab,"Position (nt)")) xat - 172 else xat
  }
  plot(x,rep(1,length(x)),pch=16,cex=0,log=logxy,ylim=ylim,axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)

  axis(2, at = yat,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1, at = xat, labels=xlabels, lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)
  if (top_position_axis) {
    axis(3, at = xat, labels=top_xlabels, lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
    mtext(top_xlab, side=3, line=1.2, cex=0.9)
  }
    title(ylab=metric_label(ylab),xlab=metric_label(xlab), line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
add_grid(grid)
  box()}

}

add_stdoneCRE <- function(loci,sorted_test_set,se_sorted,toplot,col.){
       polygon( c(loci[sorted_test_set,], rev(loci[sorted_test_set,])),          c(toplot[sorted_test_set,]+se_sorted, rev(toplot[sorted_test_set,]-se_sorted)),   col = alpha(col.,transparency_level),     border = NA              )
}
mean_context <- function(x=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=F],prefix="FHmovefho1_"){
  rn <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(prefix,"[0-9]*_",sep=""),bc_full_list)]
n <- sub(paste0("^",prefix,"([0-9]+)_.+$"), "\\1", rn)

mean_by_n <- tapply(x[rn, ], n, mean,na.rm=T)
sd_by_n <- tapply(x[rn, ], n, sd,na.rm=T)
mean_regP_k4fh <- data.frame(mean = as.vector(mean_by_n) ,sd = as.vector(sd_by_n) ,row.names = paste0(prefix,names(mean_by_n),"_mean"))
return(mean_regP_k4fh)
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
tfmove_3line <- function(toplot,std_df,ylab,CRE_prefix=fh_candidate,patt1 = "FHmovefho1_",patt2="[0-9]*",ylim=c(-1.5,8),ylabels=c(0,1,2,3,4),logy=FALSE,grid=c(1,2,3,4)){
  print(c(patt1,patt2,CRE_prefix))
  #patt1 <- "FHsfla"  #"FHsfla"
  #patt2 <- "ho1_"   #"ho2_"
  
  test_set <- character(0)
  first_cre <- NA
  for (i in CRE_prefix) {
    test_set_i <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,"[0-9]*_",i,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
    test_set_i <- intersect(test_set_i, intersect(row.names(toplot), row.names(std_df)))
    if (length(test_set_i) > 0) {
      test_set <- test_set_i
      first_cre <- i
      break
    }
  }
  if (length(test_set) == 0) {
    plot(NA, NA, xlab="Position (nt)", ylab=ylab, pch=16, cex=0, ylim=ylim, axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)
    axis(2, at = ylabels,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
    axis(1, at = c(22,52,82,112), labels = c(-150,-120,-90,-60), lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)
    title(ylab=metric_label(ylab),xlab="Position (nt)", line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
    add_grid(grid)
    box()
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  loci_ <- gsub(paste("_",first_cre,".*",sep=""),"",gsub(paste(".*",patt1,sep=""),"",test_set))
  loci <- data.frame(loci=as.numeric(loci_),row.names = test_set)
  setcol <- rev(viridis(max(loci)))

  #plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab="Activity FC",pch=16,cex=0,log="",ylim=c(min(toplot[bothleftright,],na.rm = T),max(toplot[bothleftright,],na.rm = T)),axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)
  if(logy){
    plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab=ylab,pch=16,cex=0,log="y",ylim=ylim,axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)
  }else{
    plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab=ylab,pch=16,cex=0,log="",ylim=ylim,axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)
  }
  axis(2, at = ylabels,   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1, at = c(22,52,82,112), labels = c(-150,-120,-90,-60), lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)
    title(ylab=metric_label(ylab),xlab="Position (nt)", line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
add_grid(grid)
  box()
  for (i in CRE_prefix) {
    test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,"[0-9]*_",i,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
    test_set <- intersect(test_set, intersect(row.names(toplot), row.names(std_df)))
    if (length(test_set) < 2) {
      next
    }
    loci_ <- gsub(paste("_",i,".*",sep=""),"",gsub(paste(".*",patt1,sep=""),"",test_set))
    loci <- data.frame(loci=as.numeric(loci_),row.names = test_set)
    sorted_test_set <- test_set[order(loci$loci)]
    se_sorted <- std_df[sorted_test_set,]

    add_stdoneCRE(loci,sorted_test_set,se_sorted,toplot,col_df[i,])
    add_lineoneCRE(loci,sorted_test_set,se_sorted,toplot,col_df[i,])
    draw_regression_line(loci[sorted_test_set,], toplot[sorted_test_set,],col_df[i,])

  }

 
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=4.5, fig.height=2.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
position_regression_pvalue <- function(toplot, CRE_prefix, patt1 = "FHmovefho1_"){
  test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,"[0-9]*_",CRE_prefix,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  test_set <- intersect(test_set, row.names(toplot))
  if (length(test_set) < 3) {
    return(NA)
  }
  loci_ <- gsub(paste("_",CRE_prefix,".*",sep=""),"",gsub(paste(".*",patt1,sep=""),"",test_set))
  loci <- data.frame(loci=as.numeric(loci_),row.names = test_set)
  sorted_test_set <- test_set[order(loci$loci)]
  x <- loci[sorted_test_set,,drop=FALSE]
  y <- toplot[sorted_test_set,,drop=FALSE]
  ok <- complete.cases(x[,1], y[,1])
  if (sum(ok) < 3) {
    return(NA)
  }
  fit_df <- data.frame(x=x[ok,1], y=y[ok,1])
  fit <- lm(y ~ x, data=fit_df)
  summary(fit)$coefficients["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]
}

position_pvalue_heatmap <- function(patt1 = "FHmovefho1_"){
  pvalue_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(fh_candidate), ncol=7)
  row.names(pvalue_mat) <- fh_candidate
  colnames(pvalue_mat) <- c("regP_FH","regP_F","regPH","synergy","Abasal","EC50","n")
  toplot_list <- list(
    regP_FH = gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=FALSE],
    regP_F = gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[,"regP",drop=FALSE],
    regPH = gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[,"regP",drop=FALSE],
    synergy = gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"synergy",drop=FALSE],
    Abasal = gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"basal",drop=FALSE],
    EC50 = gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[smallError_list3,"EC50",drop=FALSE],
    n = gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[smallError_list3,"n",drop=FALSE]
  )
  for (i in fh_candidate) {
    for (j in names(toplot_list)) {
      pvalue_mat[i,j] <- position_regression_pvalue(toplot_list[[j]], CRE_prefix=i, patt1=patt1)
    }
  }
  context_order <- c("L1_highFH","chr2_231915124_231915324","chr1_57433643_57433843")
  context_label <- c("L1_highFH"="CREa",
                     "chr2_231915124_231915324"="CREb",
                     "chr1_57433643_57433843"="CREc")
  pvalue_mat <- pvalue_mat[context_order,,drop=FALSE]
  row.names(pvalue_mat) <- context_label[context_order]
  pvalue_label <- ifelse(is.na(pvalue_mat), "",
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.0001, "****",
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.001, "***",
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.01, "**",
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.05, "*", "n.s.")))))
  pvalue_score <- ifelse(is.na(pvalue_mat), NA,
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.0001, 4,
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.001, 3,
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.01, 2,
                         ifelse(pvalue_mat < 0.05, 1, 0)))))
  row.names(pvalue_label) <- row.names(pvalue_mat)
  colnames(pvalue_label) <- colnames(pvalue_mat)
  pheatmap(
    pvalue_score,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = c("#F2F2F2","#E1F0E8","#BADFCF","#83C5BE","#4E9FA6"),
    breaks = seq(-0.5,4.5,1),
    border_color = NA,
    display_numbers = pvalue_label,
    number_color = "black",
    labels_col = expression(
      "RegP"~"(iFH)",
      "RegP"~"(iF)",
      "RegP"~"(iH)",
      "Synergy",
      "A"[textstyle("basal")]~"(iFH)",
      "EC"[textstyle("50")]~"(iFH)",
      "n"[textstyle("H")]~"(iFH)"
    ),
    main = "P-value of trend-line slope",
    cellwidth = 28,
    cellheight = 12
  )
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.8,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
run_anova_dist <- function(pattern){all_test_set  <-bc_full_list[grep(pattern,bc_full_list)]
all_test_set_config <- sapply(strsplit(all_test_set,"_"), `[`, 1)
all_test_set_pos <- gsub("FHs[fh][lr]a","",gsub("[fh]o[12]","",all_test_set_config))
all_test_set_lr <- gsub("FHs[fh]","",gsub("a[0-9]*[fh]o[12]","",all_test_set_config))
all_test_set_dist<-c()
for (i in c(1:length(all_test_set))) {
  all_test_set_dist[i] <-abs( which.max(hnf4a_score_perPos_bothO[all_test_set[i],])-which.max(foxa1_score_perPos_bothO[all_test_set[i],]))
}
#all_test_set_dist[which(all_test_set_lr=="l")] <-as.character( as.numeric(all_test_set_pos[which(all_test_set_lr=="l")])-min(as.numeric(all_test_set_pos)))
#all_test_set_dist[which(all_test_set_lr=="r")] <- as.character(max(as.numeric(all_test_set_pos))-as.numeric(all_test_set_pos[which(all_test_set_lr=="r")]))

all_test_set_anchorTF <- gsub("FHs","",gsub("[lr]a[0-9]*[fh]o[12]","",all_test_set_config))
all_test_set_o <- gsub("FHs[fh][lr]a[0-9]*[fh]","",all_test_set_config)

df_foranova <- data.frame(y=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[all_test_set,]$regP,
                          x1=gsub("^.*[fh]o[12]_","",all_test_set),
                          x2=factor(all_test_set_pos),
                          x3=factor(all_test_set_dist),
                          x4=factor(all_test_set_lr),
                          x5=factor(all_test_set_anchorTF),
                          x6=factor(all_test_set_o),row.names = all_test_set
                          )
model <- aov(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4+ x5+x6, data = df_foranova)

# ANOVA table
anova_out <- anova(model)
ss_total <- sum(anova_out$"Sum Sq")

# Add % variance explained column
anova_out$Percent <- (anova_out$"Sum Sq" / ss_total) * 100
print(anova_out)}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=5, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
mean_context_d <- function(x=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=F],prefix="FHshla",patt2="fo1"){
  rn <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(prefix,"[0-9]*",patt2,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
n <- sub(paste0("^",prefix,"([0-9]+)",patt2,".+$"), "\\1", rn)

mean_by_n <- tapply(x[rn, ], n, mean)
sd_by_n <- tapply(x[rn, ], n, sd)
mean_regP_k4fh <- data.frame(mean = as.vector(mean_by_n) ,sd = as.vector(sd_by_n) ,row.names = paste0(prefix,names(mean_by_n),patt2,"_mean"))
return(mean_regP_k4fh)
}

      sorted_test_set <- test_set[order(loci$loci)]
    se_sorted <- mean_regP_k4fh[,"sd",drop=F][sorted_test_set,]

    add_stdoneCRE(loci,sorted_test_set,se_sorted,mean_regP_k4fh[,"mean",drop=F],"purple")
    add_lineoneCRE(loci,sorted_test_set,se_sorted,mean_regP_k4fh[,"mean",drop=F],"purple")
}
```

### la and ra

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
lr_mean <- function(ylab,col="regP",CRE_prefix="mean",patt1 = "FHsf",patt2="ho1",
                    ylim=c(0.5,5.5),label_loci=T,plot_synergy=FALSE){
  l_patt1 <- paste0(patt1,"la")
  r_patt1 <- paste0(patt1,"ra")
  plot_k1f <- !grepl("f$", patt1)
  plot_k3h <- !grepl("h$", patt1)
  mirror_mean <- function(l_df, r_df) {
    loci_ <- sub(paste0("^",l_patt1,"([0-9]+)",patt2,".+$"), "\\1", row.names(l_df))
    r_df[paste0(r_patt1,136-as.numeric(loci_),patt2,"_mean"),,drop=FALSE]
  }
  l_mean_regP_k4fh <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,col,drop=F],prefix=l_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  r_mean_regP_k4fh <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,col,drop=F],prefix=r_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  l_mean_regP_k1f <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[,col,drop=F],prefix=l_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  r_mean_regP_k1f <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[,col,drop=F],prefix=r_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  l_mean_regP_k3h <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[,col,drop=F],prefix=l_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  r_mean_regP_k3h <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[,col,drop=F],prefix=r_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  l_mean_synergy <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"synergy",drop=F],prefix=l_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  r_mean_synergy <- mean_context_d(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"synergy",drop=F],prefix=r_patt1,patt2=patt2)
  r_mean_regP_k4fh_mirror <- mirror_mean(l_mean_regP_k4fh, r_mean_regP_k4fh)
  r_mean_regP_k1f_mirror <- mirror_mean(l_mean_regP_k1f, r_mean_regP_k1f)
  r_mean_regP_k3h_mirror <- mirror_mean(l_mean_regP_k3h, r_mean_regP_k3h)
  r_mean_synergy_mirror <- mirror_mean(l_mean_synergy, r_mean_synergy)
  lr_points <- function(x, y, col, pch=21, cex=0.75) {
    points(x, y, col=col, bg=alpha(col,0.33), pch=pch, cex=cex, lwd=0.9)
  }

  xat <- pretty(ylim, n=4)
  position_canvas(x=seq(ylim[1], ylim[2], length.out=100),
                  ylab="F anchored right", ylim=ylim,
                  grid=c(), yat=xat, xat=xat, xlab="F anchored left")
  lines(ylim, ylim, col=alpha("gray",0.75), lty=5, lwd=1)
  lr_points(l_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,r_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,
            col="#9075ab")
  if (plot_k1f) {
    lr_points(l_mean_regP_k1f$mean,r_mean_regP_k1f$mean,
              col="#E86F77")
  }
  if (plot_k3h) {
    lr_points(l_mean_regP_k3h$mean,r_mean_regP_k3h$mean,
              col="#4192D9")
  }
  R_k4fh <- cor(l_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,r_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,use="complete.obs")
  R_k1f <- cor(l_mean_regP_k1f$mean,r_mean_regP_k1f$mean,use="complete.obs")
  R_k3h <- cor(l_mean_regP_k3h$mean,r_mean_regP_k3h$mean,use="complete.obs")
  usr <- par("usr")
  text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
       labels=paste0("FH R=",signif(R_k4fh,2)), col="#9075ab", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.38*diff(usr[3:4]),
       labels="same position", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  if (plot_k1f) {
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.18*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("F R=",signif(R_k1f,2)), col="#E86F77", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  }
  if (plot_k3h) {
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.28*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("H R=",signif(R_k3h,2)), col="#4192D9", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  }

  position_canvas(x=seq(ylim[1], ylim[2], length.out=100),
                  ylab="F anchored right", ylim=ylim,
                  grid=c(), yat=xat, xat=xat, xlab="F anchored left")
  lines(ylim, ylim, col=alpha("gray",0.75), lty=5, lwd=1)
  lr_points(l_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,r_mean_regP_k4fh_mirror$mean,
            col="#9075ab")
  if (plot_k1f) {
    lr_points(l_mean_regP_k1f$mean,r_mean_regP_k1f_mirror$mean,
              col="#E86F77")
  }
  if (plot_k3h) {
    lr_points(l_mean_regP_k3h$mean,r_mean_regP_k3h_mirror$mean,
              col="#4192D9")
  }
  R_k4fh_mirror <- cor(l_mean_regP_k4fh$mean,r_mean_regP_k4fh_mirror$mean,use="complete.obs")
  R_k1f_mirror <- cor(l_mean_regP_k1f$mean,r_mean_regP_k1f_mirror$mean,use="complete.obs")
  R_k3h_mirror <- cor(l_mean_regP_k3h$mean,r_mean_regP_k3h_mirror$mean,use="complete.obs")
  usr <- par("usr")
  text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
       labels=paste0("FH R=",signif(R_k4fh_mirror,2)), col="#9075ab", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.38*diff(usr[3:4]),
       labels="same F-H distance", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  if (plot_k1f) {
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.18*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("F R=",signif(R_k1f_mirror,2)), col="#E86F77", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  }
  if (plot_k3h) {
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.28*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("H R=",signif(R_k3h_mirror,2)), col="#4192D9", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  }

  if (plot_synergy) {
    synergy_ylim <- range(c(l_mean_synergy$mean,
                            r_mean_synergy$mean,
                            r_mean_synergy_mirror$mean), finite=TRUE)
    synergy_pad <- diff(synergy_ylim)*0.08
    if (!is.finite(synergy_pad) || synergy_pad == 0) {
      synergy_pad <- 0.5
    }
    synergy_ylim <- synergy_ylim + c(-1,1)*synergy_pad
    synergy_at <- pretty(synergy_ylim, n=4)
    position_canvas(x=seq(synergy_ylim[1], synergy_ylim[2], length.out=100),
                    ylab="F anchored right", ylim=synergy_ylim,
                    grid=c(), yat=synergy_at, xat=synergy_at,
                    xlab="F anchored left")
    lines(synergy_ylim, synergy_ylim, col=alpha("gray",0.75), lty=5, lwd=1)
    lr_points(l_mean_synergy$mean,r_mean_synergy$mean,
              col=synergy_col)
    R_synergy <- cor(l_mean_synergy$mean,r_mean_synergy$mean,use="complete.obs")
    usr <- par("usr")
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("R=",signif(R_synergy,2)), col=synergy_col, adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.18*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels="same position", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)

    position_canvas(x=seq(synergy_ylim[1], synergy_ylim[2], length.out=100),
                    ylab="F anchored right", ylim=synergy_ylim,
                    grid=c(), yat=synergy_at, xat=synergy_at,
                    xlab="F anchored left")
    lines(synergy_ylim, synergy_ylim, col=alpha("gray",0.75), lty=5, lwd=1)
    lr_points(l_mean_synergy$mean,r_mean_synergy_mirror$mean,
              col=synergy_col)
    R_synergy_mirror <- cor(l_mean_synergy$mean,r_mean_synergy_mirror$mean,use="complete.obs")
    usr <- par("usr")
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0("R=",signif(R_synergy_mirror,2)), col=synergy_col, adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.18*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels="same F-H distance", adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
  }

}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
### 68 is the mid point; left + right = 136

plot_format <- function(x,y,xlab="F anchored left",ylab="F anchored right",ylim=NULL,panel_label=""){
  if (is.null(ylim)) {
    ylim <- range(c(x,y), finite=TRUE)
    ylim_pad <- diff(ylim)*0.08
    if (!is.finite(ylim_pad) || ylim_pad == 0) {
      ylim_pad <- 0.5
    }
    ylim <- ylim + c(-1,1)*ylim_pad
  }
  xy_at <- pretty(ylim, n=4)
  position_canvas(x=seq(ylim[1], ylim[2], length.out=100),
                  ylab=ylab, ylim=ylim, grid=c(),
                  yat=xy_at, xat=xy_at, xlab=xlab)
  lines(ylim, ylim, col=alpha("gray",0.75), lty=5, lwd=1)
  usr <- par("usr")
  text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]), usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
       labels=panel_label, adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
}

same_pos_fhmove <- data.frame(paste("FHmovefho1_",loci_,gsub("^FH.*[fh]o[12]","",test_set_allc),sep=""),row.names = test_set_allc)

          test_set_sameD_ra[i,] <- gsub("la","ra",gsub(paste(patt1,loci[i,],patt2,sep=""),paste(patt1,136-loci[i,],patt2,sep=""),test_set_allc[i]) )
      }
      add_cre_R <- function(x, y, labels=CRE_prefix) {
        usr <- par("usr")
        for (j in seq_along(labels)) {
          r_here <- cor(x[[labels[j]]], y[[labels[j]]], use="complete.obs")
          text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]),
               usr[4] - (0.18 + 0.10*(j-1))*diff(usr[3:4]),
               labels=paste0(c("L1","chr1","chr2")[match(labels[j], fh_candidate)],
                             " R=",signif(r_here,2)),
               col=col_df[labels[j],], adj=c(0,1), cex=0.75)
        }
      }

 # plot(toplot[test_set_allc,],toplot[test_set_ra,],cex=0,xlab="F anchored left", ylab="F anchored right",main=paste(ylab,"same pos"))
plot_format(toplot[test_set_allc,],toplot[test_set_ra,],
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=5, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
leftright <- function(toplot,std_df,ylab,CRE_prefix="chr2",patt1 = "FHsfla",patt2="ho1_",col="green",ylim=c(-1,5)){
  print(c(CRE_prefix,patt1,patt2))
  #patt1 <- "FHsfla"  #"FHsfla"
  #patt2 <- "ho1_"   #"ho2_"
  
  
  #Hsla64o2_chr9
  test_set <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,".*",patt2,CRE_prefix,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  ref_na <-bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1,"NA_",CRE_prefix,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  loci_ <- gsub(paste(patt2,".*",sep=""),"",gsub(paste(".*",patt1,sep=""),"",test_set))
  loci <- data.frame(loci=as.numeric(loci_),row.names = test_set)
  
  setcol <- rev(viridis(max(loci)))
  
  bothleftright <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(gsub("la","",patt1),".*",patt2,CRE_prefix,sep=""),bc_full_list)]

  
  #plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab="Activity FC",pch=16,cex=0,log="",ylim=c(min(toplot[bothleftright,],na.rm = T),max(toplot[bothleftright,],na.rm = T)),axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)
    plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab="Activity FC",pch=16,cex=0,log="",ylim=ylim,axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE)

  axis(2, at = c(0,1,2,3,4),   lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1, at = c(22,52,82,112), labels = c(-150,-120,-90,-60), lwd = 1, tck = -0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks = "black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)
    title(ylab=metric_label(ylab),xlab="Position (nt)", line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)

  box()
  sorted_test_set <- test_set[order(loci$loci)]
  se_sorted <- std_df[sorted_test_set,]
       polygon( c(loci[sorted_test_set,], rev(loci[sorted_test_set,])),          c(toplot[sorted_test_set,]+se_sorted, rev(toplot[sorted_test_set,]-se_sorted)),   col = alpha(col,0.5),     border = NA              )

    lines(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],col=col, lwd = line_width*1.,lty=2)
        lines(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],col=col, lwd = line_width*1.2,lty=3)

  #lines(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],col="white", lwd = line_width,lty=3)
  lines(c(min(loci$loci)-2,max(loci$loci)+2),rep(toplot[ref_na,],2),col="darkgray",lty=2, lwd = line_width)
  text(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],loci[sorted_test_set,],cex = 0.5)
  
  la <- data.frame(toplot[test_set,],row.names = loci$loci)
  
  patt1_ra <- gsub("la","ra",patt1)  #"FHsfla"
#  patt2 <- "ho1_"   #"ho2_"
    
  #Hsla64o2_chr9
  test_set_ra <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt1_ra,".*",patt2,CRE_prefix,sep=""),bc_full_list)]
  
  loci_ra_ <- gsub(paste(patt2,".*",sep=""),"",gsub(paste(".*",patt1_ra,sep=""),"",test_set_ra))
  loci_ra <- data.frame(loci=as.numeric(loci_ra_),row.names = test_set_ra)
  
  setcol <- rev(viridis(max(loci_ra)))
  
  #plot(loci$loci,toplot[test_set,],xlab="Position (nt)",ylab="Response FC",pch=16,cex=0)
  sorted_test_set_ra <- test_set_ra[order(loci_ra$loci)]
    se_sorted_ra <- std_df[sorted_test_set_ra,]
       polygon( c(loci_ra[sorted_test_set_ra,], rev(loci_ra[sorted_test_set_ra,])),          c(toplot[sorted_test_set_ra,]+se_sorted_ra, rev(toplot[sorted_test_set_ra,]-se_sorted_ra)),   col = alpha(col,0.5),     border = NA              )

           lines(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],col=col, lwd = line_width*1.,lty=2)
        lines(loci[sorted_test_set,],toplot[sorted_test_set,],col=col, lwd = line_width*1.2,lty=3)

  lines(loci_ra[sorted_test_set_ra,],toplot[sorted_test_set_ra,],col=col,lty=1, lwd = line_width)
  lines(c(min(loci_ra$loci)-2,max(loci_ra$loci)+2),rep(toplot[ref_na,],2),col="darkgray",lty=2, lwd = line_width)
  text(loci_ra[sorted_test_set_ra,],toplot[sorted_test_set_ra,],loci_ra[sorted_test_set_ra,],cex = 0.5)
  
  
  ra <- data.frame(toplot[test_set_ra,],row.names = loci$loci)
  
 # plot(la[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],ra[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],xlab=" |tf1|  tf2 ->", ylab="tf2 -> |tf1| ")
  #draw_diag()
 # text(85,max(toplot[bothleftright,],na.rm = T)*.8,round(cor(la[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],ra[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],use="pairwise.complete.obs"),3))
    print(cor(la[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],ra[c(min(loci$loci):max(loci$loci)),],use="pairwise.complete.obs"))

}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=2.85, fig.height=3.16,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
kd_diff_cut <- 1/0.9

othertf_plot <- function(patt,toplot,ylim=c(-5,5),kd_diff_cut_f =kd_diff_cut,  kd_diff_cut_h =kd_diff_cut){
  othertf_list_tag <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt,sep=""),bc_full_list)]

  #othertf_list_tag <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt,"[L].*",sep=""),bc_full_list)]

original_df <- data.frame(name=rep(NA,length(othertf_list)),row.names = othertf_list)

for (i in othertf_list_tag) {
    tmp <-   strsplit(i,";")[[1]]
    if(sum(as.numeric(strsplit(tmp[2],"")[[1]])) == 0){
      original_df[gsub(patt,"",tmp[1]),] <- i
    }
}
othertf_df <- data.frame(delta=rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         cre=gsub(";.*","",gsub(patt,"",othertf_list_tag)),
                         tfn = rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         tfl = rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         label=rep(patt,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         row.names = othertf_list_tag)

for (i in othertf_list_tag) {
    tmp <-   strsplit(i,";")[[1]]
    othertf_df[i,]$tfl <- paste(tmp[(2*c(1:(length(tmp[-c(1,2)])/2))+1)],collapse = "-")
    othertf_df[i,]$tfn <- as.character(sum(as.numeric(strsplit(tmp[2],"")[[1]])))
    original_tag <- original_df[gsub(patt,"",tmp[1]),]
    othertf_df[i,]$delta <- toplot[i,] -  toplot[original_tag,]
    if(abs(log(kd_score_F_table[i,]$kas/kd_score_F_table[original_tag,]$kas))>log(kd_diff_cut_f)  || abs(log(kd_score_H_table[i,]$kas/kd_score_H_table[original_tag,]$kas))>log(kd_diff_cut_h) ){ # || !(i %in% smallError_list3)
      othertf_df <- othertf_df[-which(rownames(othertf_df) == i),]
    }
}
#unique_delta <- c()
unique_othertf_df <- data.frame()
### some of the mut/con, especially con, actually did not change BS, because it's already con, producing duplicates and falsely high counts
for (i in row.names(othertf_df)) {
    if( othertf_df[i,]$tfn == 0){    unique_othertf_df <-  rbind(unique_othertf_df, othertf_df[i,])}
}
for (i in row.names(othertf_df)) {
  if(othertf_df[i,]$tfn>0){
  if(othertf_df[i,]$delta %in% unique_othertf_df$delta  ){
    curr_index <- which(unique_othertf_df$delta == othertf_df[i,]$delta)[1]
 #       print(paste(curr_index,i,sep="-"))
    if(othertf_df[i,]$tfn < unique_othertf_df[curr_index,]$tfn){
      unique_othertf_df <-  unique_othertf_df[-curr_index,]
      unique_othertf_df <-  rbind(unique_othertf_df, othertf_df[i,])
    }
  }else{
    unique_othertf_df <-  rbind(unique_othertf_df, othertf_df[i,])
  }
  }
}

#boxplot(toplot[othertf_list_tag,]~othertf_df$tfn)

#boxplot(othertf_df[othertf_list_tag,]$delta~othertf_df$tfn,ylim=ylim)
  med <- tapply(unique_othertf_df[["delta"]], unique_othertf_df$tfn, median)
print(cor.test(med, as.numeric(names(med)),method="spearman")$p.value)
unique_othertf_df$fn <- as.numeric(unique_othertf_df$tfn)
#print(cor.test(unique_othertf_df$delta, as.numeric(unique_othertf_df$tfn),method="spearman")$p.value)
return(unique_othertf_df)
}
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=4.5, fig.height=3.8,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
kd_diff_cut <- 1/0.9

othertf_plot <- function(patt,toplot,ylim=c(-5,5),kd_diff_cut_f =kd_diff_cut,  kd_diff_cut_h =kd_diff_cut){
  othertf_list_tag <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt,sep=""),bc_full_list)]

  #othertf_list_tag <- bc_full_list[grep(paste(patt,"[L].*",sep=""),bc_full_list)]

original_df <- data.frame(name=rep(NA,length(othertf_list)),row.names = othertf_list)

for (i in othertf_list_tag) {
    tmp <-   strsplit(i,";")[[1]]
    if(sum(as.numeric(strsplit(tmp[2],"")[[1]])) == 0){
      original_df[gsub(patt,"",tmp[1]),] <- i
    }
}

othertf_df <- data.frame(delta=rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         cre=gsub(";.*","",gsub(patt,"",othertf_list_tag)),
                         tfn = rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         tfl = rep(NA,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         label=rep(patt,length(othertf_list_tag)),
                         row.names = othertf_list_tag)

for (i in othertf_list_tag) {
    tmp <-   strsplit(i,";")[[1]]
    othertf_df[i,]$tfl <- paste(tmp[(2*c(1:(length(tmp[-c(1,2)])/2))+1)],collapse = "-")
    othertf_df[i,]$tfn <- as.character(sum(as.numeric(strsplit(tmp[2],"")[[1]])))
    original_tag <- original_df[gsub(patt,"",tmp[1]),]
    othertf_df[i,]$delta <- toplot[i,] -  toplot[original_tag,]
    if(abs(log(kd_score_F_table[i,]$kas/kd_score_F_table[original_tag,]$kas))>log(kd_diff_cut_f)  || abs(log(kd_score_H_table[i,]$kas/kd_score_H_table[original_tag,]$kas))>log(kd_diff_cut_h) ){
      othertf_df <- othertf_df[-which(rownames(othertf_df) == i),]
    }
}
#unique_delta <- c()
unique_othertf_df <- data.frame()

for (i in row.names(othertf_df)) {
  if(othertf_df[i,]$delta %in% unique_othertf_df$delta){
    curr_index <- which(unique_othertf_df$delta == othertf_df[i,]$delta)
 #       print(paste(curr_index,i,sep="-"))
    if(othertf_df[i,]$tfn < unique_othertf_df[curr_index,]$tfn){
      unique_othertf_df <-  unique_othertf_df[-curr_index,]
      unique_othertf_df <-  rbind(unique_othertf_df, othertf_df[i,])
    }
  }else{
    unique_othertf_df <-  rbind(unique_othertf_df, othertf_df[i,])
  }
}

#boxplot(toplot[othertf_list_tag,]~othertf_df$tfn)

#boxplot(othertf_df[othertf_list_tag,]$delta~othertf_df$tfn,ylim=ylim)
  med <- tapply(unique_othertf_df[["delta"]], unique_othertf_df$tfn, median)
print(cor.test(med, as.numeric(names(med)),method="spearman")$p.value)

#print(cor.test(unique_othertf_df$delta, as.numeric(unique_othertf_df$tfn),method="spearman")$p.value)
return(unique_othertf_df)
}
```

### orientation

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
orientation_order <- c("ori","con","mut","rc")
orientation_list <- bc_full_list[grep("^(ori|rc_|con_|mut_)",bc_full_list)]
orientation_type <- ifelse(grepl("^ori",orientation_list),
                           "ori",
                           sub("_.*$","",orientation_list))
orientation_ori_class <- ifelse(grepl("^ori",orientation_list),
                                sub("^ori([^_]+)_.*$","\\1",orientation_list),
                                NA)
orientation_core <- ifelse(grepl("^ori",orientation_list),
                           sub("^ori[^_]+_","",orientation_list),
                           sub("^(rc|con|mut)_","",orientation_list))
orientation_core <- sub("_[FH]_[01]+$","",orientation_core)
orientation_pair_df <- data.frame(type=orientation_type,
                                  core=orientation_core,
                                  ori_class=orientation_ori_class,
                                  row.names=orientation_list)
orientation_match_df <- data.frame(core=sort(unique(orientation_pair_df$core)))
for (otype in orientation_order) {
  orientation_match_df[,otype] <- orientation_match_df$core %in%
    orientation_pair_df$core[orientation_pair_df$type == otype]
}
orientation_core_keep <- orientation_match_df$core[
  orientation_match_df$ori &
    rowSums(orientation_match_df[,c("con","mut","rc"),drop=FALSE]) > 0
]
if (length(orientation_core_keep) == 0) {
  orientation_core_keep <- names(which(table(orientation_pair_df$core) >= 2))
}
orientation_list_keep <- row.names(orientation_pair_df)[orientation_pair_df$core %in% orientation_core_keep]

orientation_wide <- function(values, ids=orientation_list_keep) {
  ids <- intersect(ids, row.names(values))
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(data.frame(core=character(0)))
  df <- data.frame(type=orientation_pair_df[ids,]$type,
                   core=orientation_pair_df[ids,]$core,
                   value=values[ids,1],
                   row.names=ids)
  df <- aggregate(value ~ core + type, df, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
  wide <- reshape(df, idvar="core", timevar="type", direction="wide")
  names(wide) <- sub("^value\\.","",names(wide))
  wide
}

orientation_k4fh_regP <- orientation_wide(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=FALSE])
orientation_synergy <- orientation_wide(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"synergy",drop=FALSE])
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=500}
fxh_con <- conc_foxa1 * conc_hnf4a
line_width <- if (exists("line_width")) line_width else 1.5
hill_equation <- function(parS,xx){parS$basal + (parS$Fmax-parS$basal)/(1+(parS$Kd^(parS$n))/(xx^parS$n))}
orientation_colfunc <- colorRampPalette(c("#E4DEEA","#C9BCD6", "#9075ab"))
orientation_cutoff <- 1.5
orientation_sort_metric <- fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s1/fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean$s5
orientation_curve_colors <- rep("#C5C5C5",length(orientation_sort_metric))
names(orientation_curve_colors) <- row.names(fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean)
orientation_above_cutoff <- which(is.finite(orientation_sort_metric) &
                                    orientation_sort_metric > orientation_cutoff)
orientation_curve_colors[orientation_above_cutoff] <-
  orientation_colfunc(length(orientation_above_cutoff))[rank(orientation_sort_metric[orientation_above_cutoff])]
orientation_ylim <-c(0.5,140)
orientation_yat <- c(1,5,25,125)

orientation_hill_par <- function(seq_name) {
  list(basal=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_name,]$basal,
       Fmax=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_name,]$Fmax,
       Kd=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_name,]$Kd,
       n=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[seq_name,]$n/2)
}

orientation_hill_y <- function(seq_name, range_x) {
  hill_equation(orientation_hill_par(seq_name), range_x)
}

orientation_rc_count <- function(seq_name) {
  binary_label <- sub(".*_([01]+)$","\\1",seq_name)
  if (!grepl("^[01]+$",binary_label)) return(NA)
  sum(strsplit(binary_label,"")[[1]] == "1")
}
orientation_rc_pch <- function(seq_name) {
  rc_n <- orientation_rc_count(seq_name)
  pch_by_count <- c("0"=1,"1"=2,"2"=3,"3"=7,"4"=8,"5"=4,"6"=0)
  pch_here <- pch_by_count[as.character(rc_n)]
  if (length(pch_here) == 0 || is.na(pch_here)) pch_here <- 4
  unname(pch_here)
}

orientation_model_par <- function(seq_name, par_df, n_scale=1) {
  list(basal=par_df[seq_name,]$basal,
       Fmax=par_df[seq_name,]$Fmax,
       Kd=par_df[seq_name,]$Kd,
       n=par_df[seq_name,]$n/n_scale)
}

orientation_model_y <- function(seq_name, range_x, par_df, n_scale=1) {
  hill_equation(orientation_model_par(seq_name, par_df, n_scale), range_x)
}

orientation_line_range <- function(xlim) {
  exp(seq(log(xlim[1]),log(xlim[2]),0.2))
}

orientation_plot_xlim <- function(range_x, pad=0.02) {
  exp(log(range(range_x)) + c(-1,1)*pad*diff(log(range(range_x))))
}

orientation_set_canvas_noaxis <- function(x,xlim=NULL,ylim=orientation_ylim,
                                          yat=orientation_yat,xat,xlabels="",
                                          xaxis=FALSE,yaxis=FALSE){
  plot(x, (c(1:8)-0.995)*30, log="xy", xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim,
       pch=16, cex=0, col="white",
       axes=FALSE, ann=FALSE)
  if(yaxis){axis(2, at=yat, lwd=1, tck=-0.015,
                 col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=2, cex.axis=0.8)}
  if(xaxis){axis(1, at=xat, labels=xlabels, lwd=1, tck=-0.015,
                 col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8)}
  box()
}

plot_ori_rc_panel <- function(ori_ids, rc_ids, x, xlim, xat, xlabels,
                              matrix_mean, par_df, model_name, model_col,
                              n_scale=1, topat=NULL, toplabels=NULL,
                              curve_colors=NULL, xaxis=FALSE, yaxis=FALSE,
                              col_label=NULL, row_label=NULL,
                              ylim=orientation_ylim, yat=orientation_yat,
                              rc_col="#A995BC") {
  plot_ids <- intersect(c(ori_ids,rc_ids), row.names(par_df))
  plot_ids <- intersect(plot_ids, row.names(matrix_mean))
  range_x <- orientation_line_range(xlim)
  plot_xlim <- orientation_plot_xlim(range_x)
  if (length(plot_ids) == 0) {
    orientation_set_canvas_noaxis(x,xlim=plot_xlim,ylim=ylim,yat=yat,
                                  xat=xat,xlabels=xlabels,xaxis=xaxis,yaxis=yaxis)
    if (!is.null(col_label)) mtext(col_label, side=3, line=-1.2, cex=0.85)
    if (!is.null(row_label)) mtext(row_label, side=2, line=-1.2, cex=0.85)
    return(invisible(plot_ids))
  }
  orientation_set_canvas_noaxis(x,xlim=plot_xlim,ylim=ylim,yat=yat,
                                xat=xat,xlabels=xlabels,xaxis=xaxis,yaxis=yaxis)
  if (!is.null(topat) && xaxis) {
    axis(3, at=topat, labels=toplabels, lwd=1, tck=-0.015,
         col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=1.78, cex.axis=0.8)
  }
  if (!is.null(col_label)) mtext(col_label, side=3, line=-1.2, cex=0.85)
  if (!is.null(row_label)) mtext(row_label, side=2, line=-1.2, cex=0.85)

  for (seq_name in ori_ids) {
    if (!(seq_name %in% plot_ids)) next
    y <- orientation_model_y(seq_name, range_x, par_df, n_scale)
    lines(range_x,y,col=model_col,lwd=line_width,lty=1)
    points(x,as.numeric(matrix_mean[seq_name,]),
           pch=16,cex=0.85,col=model_col)
  }
  rc_ids <- rc_ids[order(orientation_sort_metric[rc_ids],decreasing=TRUE)]
  for (seq_name in rc_ids) {
    if (!(seq_name %in% plot_ids)) next
    if (orientation_rc_count(seq_name) == 0) next
    y <- orientation_model_y(seq_name, range_x, par_df, n_scale)
    line_col <- rc_col
    lines(range_x,y,col=alpha(line_col,0.8),lwd=line_width*0.7,lty=2)
    points(x,as.numeric(matrix_mean[seq_name,]),
           pch=orientation_rc_pch(seq_name),cex=0.85,col=alpha(line_col,0.8))
  }
  invisible(plot_ids)
}

plot_ori_rc_dose <- function(core=orientation_core_keep[1]) {
  ori_ids <- row.names(orientation_pair_df)[orientation_pair_df$core == core &
                                               orientation_pair_df$type == "ori"]
  rc_ids <- row.names(orientation_pair_df)[orientation_pair_df$core == core &
                                              orientation_pair_df$type == "rc"]
  plot_ori_rc_panel(ori_ids, rc_ids, fxh_con,
                    c(min(fxh_con)/1.5,max(fxh_con)*6),
                    fh_labels, f_c_labels,
                    fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean, gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh,
                    "K4FH", "#6F5688", n_scale=2,
                    topat=fh_labels, toplabels=h_c_labels,
                    curve_colors=orientation_curve_colors)
}

plot_ori_rc_grid <- function(cores=c("L1_highFH",
                                     "chr2_231915124_231915324",
                                     "chr1_57433643_57433843"),
                             core_labels=c("Context A","Context B","Context C")) {
  model_specs <- list(
    list(name="F-H", col="#6F5688", x=fxh_con,
         xlim=c(min(fxh_con)/1.5,max(fxh_con)*6),
         xat=fh_labels, xlabels=f_c_labels,
         matrix_mean=fh_hsp_matrix_3rMean, par_df=gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh,
         n_scale=2, topat=fh_labels, toplabels=h_c_labels,
         curve_colors=orientation_curve_colors, rc_col="#A995BC"),
    list(name="F", col="#E86F77", x=conc_foxa1,
         xlim=c(min(conc_foxa1)/1.5,max(conc_foxa1)*1.5),
         xat=f_c_labels, xlabels=f_c_labels,
         matrix_mean=f_hsp_matrix_3rMean, par_df=gHill_par_foxa1_k1f,
         n_scale=1, topat=NULL, toplabels=NULL,
         curve_colors=NULL, ylim=c(0.5,10), yat=c(1,5),
         rc_col="#F0A1A7"),
    list(name="H", col="#4192D9", x=conc_hnf4a_alone,
         xlim=c(min(conc_hnf4a_alone)/1.5,max(conc_hnf4a_alone)*1.5),
         xat=h_c_labels2, xlabels=h_c_labels2,
         matrix_mean=h_hsp_matrix_3rMean, par_df=gHill_par_foxa1_k3h,
         n_scale=1, topat=NULL, toplabels=NULL,
         curve_colors=NULL, ylim=c(0.5,10), yat=c(1,5),
         rc_col="#7FB4E3")
  )
  old_par <- par(mfrow=c(length(model_specs),length(cores)),
                 mar=c(0,0,0,0),
                 oma=c(3,3,0,0))
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  for (m in model_specs) {
    for (j in seq_along(cores)) {
      core <- cores[j]
      ori_ids <- row.names(orientation_pair_df)[orientation_pair_df$core == core &
                                                   orientation_pair_df$type == "ori"]
      rc_ids <- row.names(orientation_pair_df)[orientation_pair_df$core == core &
                                                  orientation_pair_df$type == "rc"]
      col_label_here <- if (m$name == "F-H") core_labels[j] else NULL
      row_label_here <- if (j == 1) m$name else NULL
      plot_ori_rc_panel(ori_ids, rc_ids, m$x, m$xlim, m$xat, m$xlabels,
                        m$matrix_mean, m$par_df, m$name, m$col,
                        n_scale=m$n_scale, topat=m$topat, toplabels=m$toplabels,
                        curve_colors=m$curve_colors, xaxis=FALSE,
                        yaxis=(j==1),
                        col_label=col_label_here,
                        row_label=row_label_here,
                        ylim=if(is.null(m$ylim)) orientation_ylim else m$ylim,
                        yat=if(is.null(m$yat)) orientation_yat else m$yat,
                        rc_col=m$rc_col)
    }
  }
}

plot_ori_rc_grid()
```

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
orientation_canvas <- function(wide, ylab, ylim=NULL, yat=NULL) {
  keep_cols <- intersect(orientation_order,names(wide))
  if (is.null(ylim)) {
    ylim <- range(wide[,keep_cols,drop=FALSE], finite=TRUE)
    pad <- diff(ylim)*0.08
    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) pad <- 0.5
    ylim <- ylim + c(-1,1)*pad
  }
  if (is.null(yat)) {
    yat <- pretty(ylim, n=4)
  }
  plot(c(1,length(orientation_order)),ylim,pch=16,cex=0,axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE,ylim=ylim)
  axis(2, at=yat, lwd=1, tck=-0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0),
       col.ticks="black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1, at=seq_along(orientation_order), labels=orientation_order, lwd=1, tck=-0.025,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=-1.9, cex.axis=0.8)
  title(ylab=metric_label(ylab), line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
  add_grid(yat)
  box()
}

orientation_paired_plot <- function(values, ylab, col="#9075ab", ylim=NULL, yat=NULL) {
  wide <- orientation_wide(values)
  keep_cols <- intersect(orientation_order,names(wide))
  wide <- wide[rowSums(is.finite(as.matrix(wide[,keep_cols,drop=FALSE]))) >= 2,,drop=FALSE]
  orientation_canvas(wide, ylab=ylab, ylim=ylim, yat=yat)
  for (i in row.names(wide)) {
    xs <- match(keep_cols, orientation_order)
    ys <- as.numeric(wide[i,keep_cols])
    lines(xs[is.finite(ys)], ys[is.finite(ys)], col=alpha("gray",0.35), lwd=0.6)
  }
  for (i in seq_along(keep_cols)) {
    points(rep(match(keep_cols[i], orientation_order), nrow(wide)),
           wide[,keep_cols[i]], pch=16, cex=0.55, col=alpha(col,0.75))
  }
  invisible(wide)
}

orientation_paired_plot(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[,"regP",drop=FALSE],
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
spacing_context <- c("L1_highFH","chr2_231915124_231915324","chr1_57433643_57433843")
spacing_context_label <- c("Context A","Context B","Context C")
spacing_context_col <- c(con1_col,con3_col,con2_col)
spacing_pattern <- data.frame(label=c("FHsfla","FHshla"),
                              patt1=c("FHsfla","FHshla"),
                              o1=c("ho1_","fo1_"),
                              o2=c("ho2_","fo2_"),
                              pch= c(21,21),# c(21,24),
                              stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
spacing_pattern_ra <- data.frame(label=c("FHsfra","FHshra"),
                              patt1=c("FHsfra","FHshra"),
                              o1=c("ho1_","fo1_"),
                              o2=c("ho2_","fo2_"),
                              pch=c(21,21),#c(21,24),
                              stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

spacing_o1_o2_df <- function(toplot,patt1="FHsfla",o1="ho1_",o2="ho2_"){
  out <- data.frame(context=character(),loci=numeric(),o1=numeric(),o2=numeric(),col=character())
  for (i in seq_along(spacing_context)) {
    core <- spacing_context[i]
    test_set_o1 <- bc_full_list[grep(paste0("^",patt1,"[0-9]+",o1,core,"$"),bc_full_list)]
    loci <- as.numeric(sub(paste0(o1,core,"$"),"",sub(paste0("^",patt1),"",test_set_o1)))
    test_set_o2 <- paste0(patt1,loci,o2,core)
    keep <- is.finite(loci) & test_set_o1 %in% row.names(toplot) & test_set_o2 %in% row.names(toplot)
    if (sum(keep) == 0) {
      next
    }
    out <- rbind(out,
                 data.frame(context=spacing_context_label[i],
                            loci=loci[keep],
                            o1=toplot[test_set_o1[keep],1],
                            o2=toplot[test_set_o2[keep],1],
                            col=spacing_context_col[i],
                            pattern=patt1))
  }
  out
}

spacing_o1_o2_df_all <- function(toplot,patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  out <- data.frame()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
    df_i <- spacing_o1_o2_df(toplot,patt1=patt_df$patt1[i],
                             o1=patt_df$o1[i],o2=patt_df$o2[i])
    if (nrow(df_i) == 0) {
      next
    }
    df_i$pattern <- patt_df$label[i]
    df_i$pch <- patt_df$pch[i]
    out <- rbind(out,df_i)
  }
  out
}

spacing_o1_o2_mean_df <- function(toplot,patt1="FHsfla",o1="ho1_",o2="ho2_"){
  loci_all <- c()
  for (core in spacing_context) {
    test_set_o1 <- bc_full_list[grep(paste0("^",patt1,"[0-9]+",o1,core,"$"),bc_full_list)]
    loci_all <- c(loci_all,as.numeric(sub(paste0(o1,core,"$"),"",sub(paste0("^",patt1),"",test_set_o1))))
  }
  loci_all <- sort(unique(loci_all[is.finite(loci_all)]))
  get_values <- function(ids) {
    values <- rep(NA_real_,length(ids))
    keep <- ids %in% row.names(toplot)
    values[keep] <- toplot[ids[keep],1]
    values
  }
  out <- data.frame(loci=numeric(),o1=numeric(),o2=numeric())
  for (locus_i in loci_all) {
    o1_ids <- paste0(patt1,locus_i,o1,spacing_context)
    o2_ids <- paste0(patt1,locus_i,o2,spacing_context)
    o1_values <- get_values(o1_ids)
    o2_values <- get_values(o2_ids)
    pair_keep <- complete.cases(o1_values,o2_values)
    if (sum(pair_keep) == 0) {
      next
    }
    out <- rbind(out,
                 data.frame(loci=locus_i,
                            o1=mean(o1_values[pair_keep]),
                            o2=mean(o2_values[pair_keep]),
                            pattern=patt1))
  }
  out
}

spacing_o1_o2_mean_df_all <- function(toplot,patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  out <- data.frame()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
    df_i <- spacing_o1_o2_mean_df(toplot,patt1=patt_df$patt1[i],
                                  o1=patt_df$o1[i],o2=patt_df$o2[i])
    if (nrow(df_i) == 0) {
      next
    }
    df_i$pattern <- patt_df$label[i]
    df_i$pch <- patt_df$pch[i]
    out <- rbind(out,df_i)
  }
  out
}

spacing_format_p <- function(p) {
  if (!is.finite(p)) {
    return("p=NA")
  }
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p<0.001")
  }
  paste0("p=",signif(p,2))
}

spacing_points <- function(x,y,pch,col,cex=0.65) {
  points(x,y,pch=pch,cex=cex,col=alpha(col,1),bg=alpha(col,0.33),lwd=0.9)
}

spacing_o1_o2_mean_plot <- function(toplot_list,ylab_list,col_list,ylim,yat,axis_label=ylab_list[1],patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  position_canvas(x=seq(ylim[1],ylim[2],length.out=100),
                  ylab=paste0("o2 ",axis_label), ylim=ylim, grid=c(),
                  yat=yat, xat=yat, xlab=paste0("o1 ",axis_label))
  lines(ylim,ylim,col=alpha("gray",0.75),lty=5,lwd=1)
  usr <- par("usr")
  draw_order <- seq_along(toplot_list)
  if ("RegP_FH" %in% ylab_list) {
    draw_order <- c(which(ylab_list != "RegP_FH"),which(ylab_list == "RegP_FH"))
  }
  for (i in draw_order) {
    df <- spacing_o1_o2_mean_df_all(toplot_list[[i]],patt_df=patt_df)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
      df_j <- df[df$pattern == patt_df$label[j],]
      spacing_points(df_j$o1,df_j$o2,pch=patt_df$pch[j],col=col_list[i])
    }
  }
  for (i in seq_along(toplot_list)) {
    df <- spacing_o1_o2_mean_df_all(toplot_list[[i]],patt_df=patt_df)
    keep_i <- complete.cases(df[,c("o1","o2")])
    r_i <- if (sum(keep_i) >= 2) cor(df$o1,df$o2,use="complete.obs") else NA
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]),
         usr[4] - (0.10 + 0.10*(i-1))*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=metric_label_with_text(ylab_list[i],
                                       paste0("R=",signif(r_i,2))),
         col=col_list[i],adj=c(0,1),cex=0.75)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

spacing_o1_o2_plot <- function(toplot,ylab,ylim,yat,patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  df <- spacing_o1_o2_df_all(toplot,patt_df=patt_df)
  position_canvas(x=seq(ylim[1],ylim[2],length.out=100),
                  ylab=paste0("o2 ",ylab), ylim=ylim, grid=c(),
                  yat=yat, xat=yat, xlab=paste0("o1 ",ylab))
  lines(ylim,ylim,col=alpha("gray",0.75),lty=5,lwd=1)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    text(mean(ylim),mean(ylim),"no paired loci",cex=0.8)
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  for (i in seq_along(spacing_context_label)) {
    df_i <- df[df$context == spacing_context_label[i],]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
      df_j <- df_i[df_i$pattern == patt_df$label[j],]
      spacing_points(df_j$o1,df_j$o2,pch=patt_df$pch[j],col=spacing_context_col[i])
    }
  }
  usr <- par("usr")
  for (i in seq_along(spacing_context_label)) {
    df_i <- df[df$context == spacing_context_label[i],]
    keep_i <- complete.cases(df_i[,c("o1","o2")])
    r_i <- if (sum(keep_i) >= 2) cor(df_i$o1,df_i$o2,use="complete.obs") else NA
    text(usr[1] + 0.07*diff(usr[1:2]),
         usr[4] - (0.10 + 0.10*(i-1))*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=paste0(spacing_context_label[i]," R=",signif(r_i,2)),
         col=spacing_context_col[i],adj=c(0,1),cex=0.75)
  }
  invisible(df)
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=2.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
spacing_o1_o2_boxplot <- function(df_list,ylab_list,col_list,ylab,ylim,yat){
  box_values <- list()
  box_cols <- c()
  box_labels <- c()
  p_values <- rep(NA_real_,length(df_list))
  for (i in seq_along(df_list)) {
    df <- df_list[[i]]
    keep <- complete.cases(df[,c("o1","o2")])
    box_values[[length(box_values)+1]] <- df$o1[keep]
    box_values[[length(box_values)+1]] <- df$o2[keep]
    box_cols <- c(box_cols,col_list[i],col_list[i])
    box_labels <- c(box_labels,paste0(ylab_list[i]," o1"),paste0(ylab_list[i]," o2"))
    p_values[i] <- if (sum(keep) >= 2) {
      tryCatch(t.test(df$o1[keep],df$o2[keep],paired=TRUE)$p.value,
               error=function(e) NA_real_)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }
  boxplot(box_values,outline=TRUE,axes=FALSE,ann=FALSE, #ylim=ylim,
          boxwex=0.45,col=alpha(box_cols,0.18),border=box_cols,
          names=rep("",length(box_values)))
  axis(2,at=yat,lwd=1,tck=-0.025,col=rgb(0,0,0,0),
       col.ticks="black",padj=1.7,cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1,at=seq_along(box_values),labels=F,lwd=1,tck=-0.025,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0),col.ticks="black",padj=-1.5,cex.axis=0.55,las=2)
  #title(ylab=ylab,line=1.2,cex.lab=1)
  box()
  usr <- par("usr")
  for (i in seq_along(df_list)) {
    text(i*2 - 0.5,usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=spacing_format_p(p_values[i]),col=col_list[i],cex=0.6)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show',dpi=300}
spacing_orientation_mean_by_locus <- function(toplot,patt1="FHsfla",o1="ho1_",o2="ho2_"){
  get_loci <- function(orientation) {
    loci_out <- c()
    for (core in spacing_context) {
      ids <- bc_full_list[grep(paste0("^",patt1,"[0-9]+",orientation,core,"$"),bc_full_list)]
      loci_out <- c(loci_out,as.numeric(sub(paste0(orientation,core,"$"),"",sub(paste0("^",patt1),"",ids))))
    }
    loci_out[is.finite(loci_out)]
  }
  get_values <- function(ids) {
    values <- rep(NA_real_,length(ids))
    keep <- ids %in% row.names(toplot)
    values[keep] <- toplot[ids[keep],1]
    values
  }
  loci_all <- sort(unique(c(get_loci(o1),get_loci(o2))))
  out <- data.frame(loci=loci_all,o1=NA_real_,o2=NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_along(loci_all)) {
    locus_i <- loci_all[i]
    o1_values <- get_values(paste0(patt1,locus_i,o1,spacing_context))
    o2_values <- get_values(paste0(patt1,locus_i,o2,spacing_context))
    if (sum(is.finite(o1_values)) > 0) {
      out$o1[i] <- mean(o1_values,na.rm=TRUE)
    }
    if (sum(is.finite(o2_values)) > 0) {
      out$o2[i] <- mean(o2_values,na.rm=TRUE)
    }
  }
  out
}

spacing_orientation_phase_cor <- function(toplot,shifts=-10:10,patt1="FHsfla",o1="ho1_",o2="ho2_"){
  mean_df <- spacing_orientation_mean_by_locus(toplot,patt1,o1,o2)
  out <- data.frame(shift=shifts,R=NA_real_,n=0)
  for (i in seq_along(shifts)) {
    shift_i <- shifts[i]
    x_df <- data.frame(loci=mean_df$loci,o1=mean_df$o1)
    y_df <- data.frame(loci=mean_df$loci - shift_i,o2=mean_df$o2)
    pair_df <- merge(x_df,y_df,by="loci")
    pair_df <- pair_df[complete.cases(pair_df[,c("o1","o2")]),]
    out$n[i] <- nrow(pair_df)
    if (nrow(pair_df) >= 2) {
      out$R[i] <- cor(pair_df$o1,pair_df$o2)
    }
  }
  out
}

spacing_orientation_phase_cor_all <- function(toplot,shifts=-10:10,patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  out <- data.frame(shift=shifts,R=NA_real_,n=0)
  for (j in seq_along(shifts)) {
    shift_i <- shifts[j]
    pair_all <- data.frame()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
      mean_df <- spacing_orientation_mean_by_locus(toplot,
                                                   patt1=patt_df$patt1[i],
                                                   o1=patt_df$o1[i],
                                                   o2=patt_df$o2[i])
      x_df <- data.frame(loci=mean_df$loci,o1=mean_df$o1)
      y_df <- data.frame(loci=mean_df$loci - shift_i,o2=mean_df$o2)
      pair_df <- merge(x_df,y_df,by="loci")
      pair_df <- pair_df[complete.cases(pair_df[,c("o1","o2")]),]
      if (nrow(pair_df) > 0) {
        pair_all <- rbind(pair_all,pair_df)
      }
    }
    out$n[j] <- nrow(pair_all)
    if (nrow(pair_all) >= 2) {
      out$R[j] <- cor(pair_all$o1,pair_all$o2)
    }
  }
  out
}

spacing_phase_plot <- function(toplot_list,ylab_list,col_list,axis_label="Pearson R",shifts=-10:10,patt_df=spacing_pattern){
  position_canvas(x=shifts,ylab=axis_label,ylim=c(-1,1),grid=c(-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1),
                  yat=c(-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1),xat=c(-10,-5,0,5,10),
                  xlab="Phase shift (o2 locus - o1 locus)")
  abline(h=0,col=alpha("gray",0.8),lwd=1)
  usr <- par("usr")
  if (nrow(patt_df) == 1) {
    text(usr[2] - 0.06*diff(usr[1:2]),usr[4] - 0.08*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=patt_df$label[1],adj=c(1,1),cex=0.75)
  }
  draw_order <- seq_along(toplot_list)
  if ("RegP_FH" %in% ylab_list) {
    draw_order <- c(which(ylab_list != "RegP_FH"),which(ylab_list == "RegP_FH"))
  }
  for (i in draw_order) {
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
      cor_df <- spacing_orientation_phase_cor(toplot_list[[i]],shifts=shifts,
                                              patt1=patt_df$patt1[j],
                                              o1=patt_df$o1[j],
                                              o2=patt_df$o2[j])
      lines(cor_df$shift,cor_df$R,col=alpha(col_list[i],0.5),lwd=line_width*0.7)
      spacing_points(cor_df$shift,cor_df$R,col=col_list[i],pch=patt_df$pch[j],cex=0.55)
    }
  }
  for (i in seq_along(toplot_list)) {
    cor_df <- data.frame()
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(patt_df))) {
      cor_j <- spacing_orientation_phase_cor(toplot_list[[i]],shifts=shifts,
                                             patt1=patt_df$patt1[j],
                                             o1=patt_df$o1[j],
                                             o2=patt_df$o2[j])
      cor_df <- rbind(cor_df,cor_j)
    }
    max_i <- if (all(is.na(cor_df$R))) NA_integer_ else which.max(cor_df$R)
    label_i <- if (is.na(max_i)) {
      metric_label_with_text(ylab_list[i],"max i=NA, R=NA")
    } else {
      metric_label_with_text(ylab_list[i],
                             paste0("max i=",cor_df$shift[max_i],
                                    ", R=",signif(cor_df$R[max_i],2)))
    }
    text(usr[1] + 0.06*diff(usr[1:2]),
         usr[4] - (0.10 + 0.10*(i-1))*diff(usr[3:4]),
         labels=label_i,
         col=col_list[i],adj=c(0,1),cex=0.75)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

### FHC 

```{r ,  eval=F,fig.width=3, fig.height=3,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show'}
x <- bc_full_list[grep("^FHC_",bc_full_list)]

count_FH <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  suffix <- parts[-1]
  
  c(
    F = sum(suffix %in% c("F", "rF")),
    H = sum(suffix %in% c("H", "rH"))
  )
}

test <- t(sapply(x, count_FH))
fhc_onlyH <- rownames(test)[test[, "F"] == 0]
fhc_onlyF <- rownames(test)[test[, "H"] == 0]
fhc_both <- rownames(test)[test[, "F"] > 0 & test[, "H"] > 0]

filter_small_error <- function(ids, col) {
  if (col %in% c("n","Kd")) {
    ids <- intersect(ids, smallError_list)
  }
  ids
}

fhc_ylab <- function(col) {
  switch(col,
         regP="RegP",
         Kd="EC50",
         n="Hill coefficient",
         basal="Abasal",
         synergy="Synergy",
         col)
}

fhc_boxplot <- function(..., names, ylab, model_label="", yat=NULL) {
  data_list <- list(...)
  if (is.null(yat)) {
    yat <- pretty(unlist(data_list), n=4)
  }
  boxplot(data_list, axes=FALSE, ann=FALSE,
          lwd=0.75, medlwd=0.8, outline=TRUE)
  axis(2, at=yat, lwd=1, tck=-0.025, col=rgb(0,0,0,0),
       col.ticks="black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8)
  axis(1, at=seq_along(names), labels=names, lwd=1, tck=-0.025,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=-1.9, cex.axis=0.75)
  title(ylab=metric_label(ylab), line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
  if (model_label != "") {
    title(main=model_label, line=0.3, cex.main=0.8)
  }
  box()
}

threeline_homohetero <- function(col="regP"){
  onlyF <- filter_small_error(fhc_onlyF, col)
  onlyH <- filter_small_error(fhc_onlyH, col)
  both <- filter_small_error(fhc_both, col)
  fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[onlyH,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[both,col],
              names=c("F only","H only","F+H"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K4FH")
if(col !="synergy"){fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[onlyH,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[both,col],
              names=c("F only","H only","F+H"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K1F")
fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[onlyH,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[both,col],
            names=c("F only","H only","F+H"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K3H")
}}

threeline_homohetero()
threeline_homohetero("Kd")
threeline_homohetero("n")
threeline_homohetero("basal")
threeline_homohetero("synergy")

is_alternating <- function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, ":")
  
  sapply(parts, function(p) {
    p <- sub("^r", "", p)  # rF -> F, rH -> H
    all(p[-1] != p[-length(p)])
  })
}

x2 <- bc_full_list[grep("^FHC_chr2",bc_full_list)]
alternating_FH <- x2[is_alternating(x2)]

only_F_chr2 <- rownames(test[x2,])[test[x2, "H"] == 0]
only_H_chr2 <- rownames(test[x2,])[test[x2, "F"] == 0]
therest <- x2[!x2 %in% c(alternating_FH, only_F_chr2, only_H_chr2)]

threeline_homohetero_moredivided <- function(col="regP"){
  alternating <- filter_small_error(alternating_FH, col)
  rest <- filter_small_error(therest, col)
  onlyF <- filter_small_error(only_F_chr2, col)
  onlyH <- filter_small_error(only_H_chr2, col)
  fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[alternating,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[rest,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh[onlyH,col],
              names=c("Alt.","Other","F only","H only"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K4FH")
  fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[alternating,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[rest,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k1f[onlyH,col],
              names=c("Alt.","Other","F only","H only"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K1F")
  fhc_boxplot(gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[alternating,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[rest,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[onlyF,col],gHill_par_foxa1_k3h[onlyH,col],
              names=c("Alt.","Other","F only","H only"), ylab=fhc_ylab(col), model_label="K3H")
}
threeline_homohetero_moredivided()
threeline_homohetero_moredivided("Kd")
threeline_homohetero_moredivided("n")

            names=c("K1F","K3H","K4FH"), ylab="Hill coefficient")
```
